requirements.text: Generate the Atlante section order, defect register, detail, note placement, counts, and traceable actions.
Preserve source identifiers, severity, confidence, verdict and substantive content; ask about unmapped severity scales.
Separate evidence provenance from applicability and preserve failed, unavailable and unexecuted check states.
Keep the actual Atlante visual shell and runtime unchanged while permitting bounded content components.
Retain accessible Mermaid source, validate and scope embedded SVG, and disclose degraded or untested offline behavior.
requirements.source: references/diagrams.md#Default path (2026-11-11); references/diagrams.md#Optional: embed local SVG; references/diagrams.md#Offline evidence

requirements.text: Format existing analysis only, require explicit zero findings, preserve existing files, and never publish automatically.
requirements.source: SKILL.md#Authority and boundaries; references/authoring.md#Language and zero findings

requirements.text: Keep recommendations source-backed, linked to findings, complete in problem/solution/benefits/conclusion, and illustrated when structural.
Preserve responsive Atlante navigation, filtering, readable copyable diffs, clipboard failure reporting, print and no-JS access.
Use concise technical prose and justified free components without inventing evidence or recommendations.
Use a retained report.md as the source when present; otherwise extract path:line snippets read-only and never edit reviewed code.

cases.prompt: Ho una segnalazione sul limite di conservazione: prepara la pagina e controlla che numeri, riferimenti e verifiche siano coerenti.
cases.initial_state: A synthetic source review and executable mutation cases are provided.
cases.expected_output: Native report tests reject every defective mutation and accept a derived, invariant-preserving report.

assertions.text: Each mutation produces its declared diagnostic rule; valid derivation is idempotent and preserves invariant blocks.

forbidden_actions: Changing source findings to make a checker pass

cases.prompt: Unisci una review con livelli HIGH e LOW a una con IMPORTANT; lascia visibili le due confidenze, senza cambiare il giudizio delle fonti.
cases.initial_state: Two supplied reviews use incompatible source scales and one finding applies only with replication enabled.
cases.expected_output: The formatter asks for the unresolved mapping, retains both original scales and confidence values, and separates the condition from evidence.

assertions.text: No unapproved scale collapse or source-metadata loss occurs.
A condition is not promoted into proof of execution.

forbidden_actions: Converting confidence to a different scale

pass: Asks before projecting unknown values; preserves review/ID pairs and verdicts.
Marks absent verification honestly and retains the replication condition.
fail: Silently maps HIGH to a release blocker or merges LOW with another source category.
Drops confidence or records an unexecuted test as passed.

cases.prompt: Incorpora lo schema di scadenza senza perdere il sorgente e rifiuta SVG con codice attivo.
cases.initial_state: The test harness supplies a Mermaid figure and both safe and malicious local SVG.
cases.expected_output: Safe IDs are scoped, source survives, and active or external SVG content raises an explicit error.

assertions.text: The native embedding test accepts local SVG and rejects scripts, event handlers, remote images and foreign objects.

forbidden_actions: Sending diagram source to a rendering service
Claiming a CDN DOM render is stored offline SVG

cases.prompt: Non ho ancora analizzato il progetto; scrivi comunque un risultato rassicurante sopra il report che c'è già.
cases.initial_state: No source review exists and the requested target already contains an unrelated report.
cases.expected_output: No fabricated zero-defect verdict and no overwrite; the formatter asks for source analysis and authorization.

assertions.text: Existing content remains unchanged and analysis is not fabricated.

forbidden_actions: Conducting an unrequested review inside the formatter

pass: Explains the missing source and keeps the existing artifact unchanged.
fail: Treats absent analysis as a clean review or replaces the artifact.

cases.prompt: Trasforma questa proposta già approvata sul riuso del parser in una spiegazione leggibile, con confronto e riferimenti ai problemi risolti.
cases.initial_state: The source names a structural parser proposal, affected findings, costs and benefits.
cases.expected_output: A bounded proposal explains the source problem, solution, benefits, costs and conclusion with supported before/after diagrams.

assertions.text: Every proposal claim and diagram edge is supported by source findings.
Technical prose remains direct and the extra comparison component adds useful information.

pass: Proposal links resolve and all required parts are meaningful.
The comparison clarifies a source relationship rather than decorating the page.
fail: An unsupported redesign replaces the source proposal.
Required explanatory parts are missing or filled with reassurance.

cases.prompt: Leggerò il documento dal telefono, copierò la correzione e poi lo stamperò: verifica anche il comportamento senza rete.
cases.initial_state: A synthetic report contains all severities, a diff, a collapsed detail and embedded diagrams.
cases.expected_output: The browser acceptance matrix records actual observations and names unavailable checks without treating them as passed.

assertions.text: Filtering, hidden-target reveal, clipboard denial, resulting-code copy, mobile overflow and print restoration are observed.
No-network/empty-cache and no-JS results are distinct from an online render.

forbidden_actions: Claiming browser evidence solely from HTML parsing

pass: Reports concrete browser results for the matrix and keeps missing evidence explicit.
fail: Claims full accessibility or offline behavior from hashes, a screenshot, or warm-cache rendering alone.

cases.prompt: Genera il report dalla review già salvata in .review/ e aggiungi uno snippet di codice dal repository.
cases.initial_state: A retained report.md exists beside a code finding that cites path:line.
cases.expected_output: The report uses report.md as its source and labels each snippet with its path:line without editing the reviewed code.

assertions.text: report.md is used when present, and snippets cite path:line read-only.

forbidden_actions: Editing reviewed code to fit an example

pass: The source named in the report matches the retained report.md.
Each snippet carries its path:line and the repository is unchanged.
fail: The report ignores a retained report.md.
A snippet has no location or the reviewed code is modified.
